heading: Recommended setup
intro: From the last 7 days of Persona's own records. Nothing was changed: each of these stays off until you turn it on.
delegate: Let Persona answer agents' own-call questions: {n} times you answered an agent's question with exactly what the conversation supervising it recommended; Persona would have answered those for you. Cost: one model call per question, and the answer reaches the agent before you see it. Where: there is no switch for it in the apps yet; it is turned on in the assistant's configuration file on the hub's computer (agents.delegate, enabled: true), as the configuration guide describes.
standing_authorizations: Standing authorizations: {n} times you approved a merge, a push or a test deploy that you had already approved in the same directory; a standing authorization would not have asked again. Cost: Persona then does that step there without asking, within the conditions on the authorization. Where: Standing authorizations in Settings.
task_trust: Start tasks directly: {n} plans waited for Start although you had already started tasks of the same kind (same computer and directory); a remembered kind starts without asking. Cost: those tasks start, and spend tokens, before you have read the plan. Where: "Start these right away from now on" on a plan card.
triage_decide: Session triage, "Card for decisions": {n} times an agent stopped to wait for you with no card and was set going again by hand; each stop would have been a card in Needs you. Cost: no extra model call beyond the triage you already run, and one more card per stop. Where: Session triage in Settings.
triage_auto_continue: Session triage, "Continue after errors": {n} times an agent that had stopped on a usage limit was continued by hand; besides temporary model errors, this switch also continues an agent once its usage limit has reset. Cost: each continue runs a turn of the agent on its own model. Where: Session triage in Settings.
triage_wake: Session triage, "Wake on schedule": {n} times an agent waiting on something else (CI, a deploy, another agent) was set going again by hand; it would have been woken to check for itself. Cost: each wake runs a turn of the agent on its own model. Where: Session triage in Settings.
leaders: Leader conversations: {n} of the main chat's rounds ({minutes} min) were follow-ups of tasks it had handed out; a pinned conversation becomes the leader of its own direction and follows up its tasks itself. Cost: each leader conversation keeps its own context and spends tokens on it. Where: Pin in a conversation's menu.
review_sample: Spot-check reviews: {n} tasks were accepted at their first review with every criterion met and the work live; with a share below 100% Persona checks each finished task's criteria itself and closes the ones that pass, without a review round. Cost: one more check per finished task, and only the share you set still comes to a review. Where: ask Persona to change "Share of finished tasks to spot-check"; you confirm on a card.
independent_review: Independent review: {n} times work that Persona's own check had called done was sent back for rework by the conversation supervising it; an independent reviewer reads each finished change first and sends back what it finds. Cost: one more agent run for every finished task. Where: there is no switch for it in the apps yet; it is turned on in the assistant's configuration file on the hub's computer (agents.review.launcher, the launcher the reviewer runs on), as the configuration guide describes.
supervisor_tier: A lower tier for the background supervisor: in the last 30 days it accepted {n} tasks on {model} that have since had their day to be reopened in, and {reopened} of them were reopened. Its provider also has {lower}, one tier down and not its smallest. Cost and risk: a lower tier spends less on every review, but accepting a task is a judgment call, and these numbers say how {model} reviewed, not how {lower} will, so more accepted tasks may be reopened. Where: Background supervisor in Model settings; Persona changed nothing.
